title: Closed mode (no model client): closed questions with single-key options; keys only, never a multi-key amount

matching.env: The server environment this script needs (GP_CARD_DELIVERY always). The E2E runner never mixes card-delivery modes in one server run: it starts one server per declared environment.
matching.expect_keys: debug.keys of the reply must equal this list exactly, in order; expect_keys_include: these keys appear in this order; expect_keys_exclude: none of these keys appears.
matching.when_pending: A conditional turn is played only when the previous reply's keys include that question key, so the script answers value-of-information questions in whichever order the plan asks them.
matching.reply: These BrainReply fields must match exactly. ask/card_url/choices/display: 'present' = non-null, 'null' = null. Reply wording is owned by the sentence bank and is not compared.
matching.fake_llm: The ExtractionResult the fake model returns for this exact utterance (data/tests/utterances.jsonl).
matching.case: Checked on the stored case after this turn (console API); final: after /end.

note: The anthropic provider with no key builds no model client, so every call runs in closed mode (docs/SPEC.md §3.7), the same mode two model failures in a row lead to. The runner never passes a key to a group that declares its own provider, and skips this script in remote mode. The delay case (a model answer later than 2.3 s) is in test_llm_faults.py.
